See also: Amapola

Cebuano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish amapola.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʔamaˈpola/ [ʔɐ.mɐˈpo.l̪ɐ]
  • Hyphenation: a‧ma‧po‧la

Noun

[edit]

amapola (Badlit spelling ᜀᜋᜉᜓᜎ)

  1. hibiscus
  2. the Dixie rosemallow (Hibiscus mutabilis)

Hiligaynon

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

amapóla

  1. poppy

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Alteration of earlier ababol.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /amaˈpola/ [a.maˈpo.la]
  • Audio (Venezuela):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ola
  • Syllabification: a‧ma‧po‧la

Noun

[edit]

amapola f (plural amapolas)

  1. poppy
    Hyponym: adormidera
    • 2022 June 1, Manuel Ansede, Olivia López Bueno, “Los vampiros del opio: un temerario turismo por los pueblos de España en busca de morfina”, in El País‎[1]:
      La ubicación de los 528 cultivos legales de adormidera es secreta, pero en primavera es imposible esconder esas 11.000 hectáreas plagadas de amapolas blancas que hay en España, según los datos del Ministerio de Sanidad.
      The location of the 528 legal poppy farms is secret, but in springtime it's impossible to hide these 11,000 hectares covered with white poppies all across Spain, according to data from the Ministry of Health.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • amapolero
  • ser más de pueblo que las amapolas

Related terms

[edit]
  • ababol

Further reading

[edit]
  • “amapola”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish amapola, alteration of ababol, from Andalusian Arabic حَبَّبَوْر (ḥabbabawr), univerbation of Arabic حَبّ (ḥabb) and Latin papāver.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔamaˈpola/ [ʔɐ.mɐˈpoː.lɐ]
  • Rhymes: -ola
  • Syllabification: a‧ma‧po‧la

Noun

[edit]

amapola (Baybayin spelling ᜀᜋᜉᜓᜎ)

  1. poppy
  2. cotton rosemallow (Hibiscus mutabilis)

See also

[edit]
  • adormidera
  • gumamela

Further reading

[edit]
  • “amapola”, in Pambansang Diksiyonaryo | Diksiyonaryo.ph, 2018
  • Cuadrado Muñiz, Adolfo (1972), Hispanismos en el tagalo: diccionario de vocablos de origen español vigentes en esta lengua filipina, Madrid: Oficina de Educación Iberoamericana, page 29
